content: Diinanne Seekeeme Dere Asaa
Liyay Yaaqoobes yelida naya Diinay he wode Seekeeme dere maccassa beyanaas kezadus.
He biittaa haariza Hiiwey Emoore naa Seekeemey izo wolqqara oykkidi laymatides.
Hessafe guye iza wozinay izin ekettides; izikka nayo keehi dosida gishshas siiqo qaalan baleththides.
Seekeemey ba aawa Emoore, «Taas hanno nayo machcho oychcharkkii!» gides.
Yaaqoobey ba naa Diinay moorettidayssa siyida wode iza attuma nayti mehera bazzon diza gishshas istti yaana gakkanaas co7u gides.
Hessafe guye Seekeeme aawa Emoorey Yaaqoobera haasayanaas yides.
Yaaqoobe attuma nayti he hanidayssa siyida mala ba dizasoppe yiidi ceecidanne shenetida; ays giikko Seekeemey Isra7eele naa bolla ooththanaas bessontta ooso ooththida gishshas daro hanqettida.
Gido attiin Emoorey isttas, «Ta naa Seekeemey intte nayo diina daro siiqiza gishshas hayyana izo izas machcho immerketii!
Nunara ekettitenne gelettite; intte macca nayta nuus immite; nu macca naytakka inttes ekkite.
Intte nu giddon uttana dandayeeta; derey keehi aaho; izan de7ite; zal7ite; izan aqo kessite» gides.
He wode Seekeemey Diina aawaanne izi ishata, «Tani intte ta gizayssa kunththizaa gidikko intte oychchizayssa ay gidikkoka ta immana.
Intte koyta
koykko immana; imota koykko intte koyidayssa keena ta immana shin nayo ta ekkana mala ero giite» gides.
Ba michcheyo Diina Seekeemey tunisida gishshas Yaaqoobe attuma nayti Seekeemessinne iza aawa Emoores wordo yootida;
isttika isttas, «Nuni hessa mala miish ooththana dandayokko; nuni nu michcheyo qaxxarettontta asas immiko hayssi nuna kawushshiza miishsha.
Nuni intte issi miish ooththiko inttes, ‹Ero› gaana; hessika aazee giikko intte biittaa attuma asay wuri nu mala qaxxarettiko.
Nuni nu macca nayta inttes immana intte macca naytakka nuus ekkana; nu intte giddon uttidi inttenara issi dere gidana.
Intte qaxxarettanaas koyonttaa gidikko nuni nu michcheyo ekkidi baana» gida.
Histtiin istti gidayssi Emooressinne iza naa Seekeemes lo7o misatides.
Ba aawa keeththan diza ubbaafe aadhdhi bonchchettida Seekeemey Yaaqoobe nayin ufayettida gishshas istti gidayssa ooththanaas gam7ibeenna.
He wode Emooreynne iza naa Seekeemey ba asaas yootanaas ba diza katama simmi biidi,
«Ha asati nunara siga; istti nu biittan dettonne zal7etto; nu derey keehi aaho; istta macca nayta nuni ekkana; isttika nu macca nayta ekketto.
Gido attiin nunara istti issi asa mala de7anaas nuni issi miish ooththanaas koshshees; hessika istti qaxxarettida mala nu attuma asay wuri qaxxarettiko hanana.
Nuni hessaththo ooththiko istta miizay, istta aqoynne istta mehey wuri nuus deennee? Hessa gishshas ane nuni istti goyssa ero goos; isttika nunara daana» gida.
Katamaa dubbushan shiiqida asay wuri Emooressinne iza naa Seekeemes, «Ero» gida. Histtiin he katama attumasay wuri qaxxarettides.

Heedzdzanththo gallas istti wuri ba qaxxara madunththaa sakettishin, Yaaqoobe attuma naytappe Diina ishati, Simooninne Lewey giththa mashsha ekkidi oonikka erontta katamaa gelidi, adde gididayta ubbaa wodhida.
Emoorenne iza naa Seekeeme giththa mashshan wodhidi ba michcheyo Diina Seekeeme sooppe kessi ekkidi bida.
Yaaqoobe attuma naytikka ahata bollara yedhetti aadhdhidi ba michcheyo Diino tunisida katamaa bonqqida.
Istta dors, deysh, miiz, hare, qasseka katamaa giddon dizayssanne gaxan dizayssa ubbaa ekkida.
Istta mehetanne istta machcheta guuththa naytara ubbaa di7i ekki bida; keeththan dizayssaka ubbaa bonqqida.

Yaaqoobey Simoonanne Lewe, «Intte ta bolla meto ehichchideta; ha biittan diza Kanaanetinne Paarizeti tana ixxana; nuni qoodan guuththa; istti issife gididi ta bolla worajjiko taninne taso asay dhayana» gides.
Gido attiin isttas, «Histtiin izi nu michcheyo layma maccassa mala ooththanaas bessizee?» gida.

footnotes.text: Koyta: Koyta guussi machchi asas imettiza miish guussa.
